change: Unicast EAPOL requests MAC ACK waiting; same seven-retry policy, sequence assignment, CCMP framing and PN policy. PHY and logging code are unchanged.

regression_before.reason: Unicast EAPOL must request a MAC ACK

allocation_gates.label: esp32c3-control-v1
allocation_gates.method: Live archive input ranges wholly inside one ELF SHF_ALLOC output section; includes COMMON, excludes discarded/debug/nonallocated inputs and linker padding. Explicitly excludes object-verified mergeable string inputs; totals are non-string allocations, not complete archive attribution.
limits: Linked-image ownership does not establish ROM or calibration replacement.
Initial state hashes do not validate runtime calibration data.
Entry placement does not prove transitive flash independence.
Instruction and hardware behavior require separate validation.
Only receive saturation and IQ-estimator controls replaced; RX/TX calibration searches and ROM remain.
Only IQ conversion and two-round correction replaced; RX/TX calibration searches, analog callbacks and ROM division remain.
RF-IQ tone orchestration and convergence replaced; receive DC/gain searches, transmit calibration and analog/ROM dependencies remain.

timing.limits: Cumulative metrics cannot correlate a particular packet with an operation. Group losses in the comparison are preserved separately. No cycle-equivalence or packet-loss fix is claimed.

final_board_state.esp32c3: ordinary source app completed and disconnected
final_board_state.esp32s3: held in ROM by paired flasher; ordinary source app retained

limits: One fixed control/source GTK trial per chip and two ordinary source restoration trials; all completed or lossy trials retained.
Four control ELFs are byte-identical reuses from the preceding RF-IQ source milestone. Four new source ELFs differ only by the FoA pin; all recorded HAL source hashes and locks are verified.
No RF, cycle, latency or long-duration reliability equivalence claim. Ethernet-side captures cannot locate every loss.
ACK waiting detects a missing link-layer ACK; a received ACK does not prove AP decryption, EAPOL acceptance or upper-layer delivery.
Per-frame group INFO logging remains present in the matched quiet/80MHz profiles.
